decisions.Trigger: Pumper 1 is the first crew on scene. Time for a first plan.

Card.headline: Cool B3 now and shelter Glenvale homes

actions.reason: Pumper 1 can cool B3 before it starts venting.
Protect Glenvale homes before HF smoke arrives.

Card.rationale: B3 is overheating without visible venting, so early cooling may prevent ignition. Work from upwind and stay at least 17 m away if venting starts.
evidence: B3 battery sensor reads 68 C and rising 1.9 C per minute.
Site wind meter reads from 265 degrees, toward Glenvale homes.
The forecast gives B3 an 86% runaway chance within 20 minutes.

expected_effect.label: Peak indoor HF at Glenvale homes

Card.confidence_reason: Testing favours early cooling, but temperature and wind lack independent checks.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If B3 vents or ignites, switch cooling to B4.
sensor_concerns: Fixed gas readings are noisy and HAZMAT 1 has not verified them.

decisions.Trigger: Aerial 1 has arrived. Its thermal camera can now check temperatures and see where the smoke goes.

Card.headline: Keep the current plan
Card.rationale: Keep Pumper 1 cooling B3 and Glenvale homes sheltered. Adding cooling at B4 showed no benefit, so keep spare crews ready.
evidence: B3 battery sensor reads 76 C and rises 2 C each minute.
Aerial 1 measures B3 skin at 42 C.
The forecast gives B3 a 58% runaway chance within 20 minutes.
Card.confidence_reason: The forecast warns of runaway, but the plan test predicts none.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If B3 starts venting or temperatures rise nearby, change cooling and crew positions.
sensor_concerns: Fixed gas readings are noisy and HAZMAT 1 has not verified them.
The wind reading has no independent smoke check yet.

decisions.Trigger: HAZMAT 1 has arrived. It can measure gas and the smoke reaching nearby homes.

Card.headline: Cool B4 and A5 now

actions.reason: Pumper 2 can protect B4 before B3 ignites.
Aerial 1 can prevent the spread predicted across the aisle.

Card.rationale: Keep Pumper 1 cooling B3 and Glenvale homes sheltered. Testing B3 at the camera estimate of 90 C favours protecting both exposures.
evidence: Aerial 1 reports B3 skin at 60 C, suggesting 90 C inside.
B3 battery sensor reports 80 C and rising.
HAZMAT 1 measures HF at Glenvale homes at 0 ppm.

expected_effect.label: Peak indoor HF at Glenvale homes

Card.confidence_reason: Both cooling orders help at the camera estimate, but predictions change sharply with temperature.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If repeat thermal readings show B3 cooling, reassess the extra streams.
sensor_concerns: B3 battery sensor reads below the camera estimate, so testing used 90 C.
Fixed gas readings exceed HAZMAT 1 readings, so trust HAZMAT 1.

decisions.Trigger: B3 is heating up. It is at 101°C and rising.

Card.headline: Keep the current plan
Card.rationale: Keep Pumper 1 cooling B3 and Pumper 2 cooling B4. Keep Aerial 1 cooling A5 and Glenvale homes sheltered because reassignment adds no predicted benefit.
evidence: B3 battery sensor reads 101 C and rising 6 C each minute.
Aerial 1 thermal camera shows B3 skin at 61 C.
The forecast gives B3 an 88% runaway chance within ten minutes.

expected_effect.label: Peak indoor HF at Glenvale homes

Card.confidence_reason: Both tested plans contain spread equally, but wind has no independent check.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If B3 starts venting or smoke turns toward Glenvale Primary, reassess immediately.
sensor_concerns: B1 fixed gas detector reads 10% while HAZMAT 1 verifies about 1%.

decisions.Trigger: B3 is venting flammable gas. Its battery is in thermal runaway.

Card.headline: Withdraw nearby crews and cool B4 with Aerial 1

actions.reason: Water on B3 cannot stop its thermal runaway.
Pumper 2 is within about 17 metres of venting B3.
Protect the closest downwind neighbour from a safer position.

Card.rationale: Let B3 burn and keep crews beyond 17 metres. Keep Glenvale homes sheltered and move Aerial 1 from cool A5 to B4.
evidence: Aerial 1 reports smoke drifting east toward Glenvale homes.
B3's battery sensor reads 157 C and rising rapidly.
The forecast gives B4 a 13% runaway chance within 20 minutes.
Card.confidence_reason: The test shows unchanged spread, but cannot predict future wind changes.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If smoke turns toward Glenvale Primary, shelter the school immediately.
sensor_concerns: A3's flat battery reading is suspicious, so testing used the camera estimate of 11 C.
B3's low gas readings do not override visible venting and confirmed thermal runaway.

Card.headline: Shelter Glenvale Primary and keep cooling B4

actions.reason: HF smoke is drifting toward Glenvale Primary.

Card.rationale: Shelter Glenvale Primary now and keep Glenvale homes sheltered. Keep Aerial 1 cooling B4 and other crews clear because extra cooling showed no benefit.
evidence: Aerial 1 reports smoke drifting northeast toward 59 degrees.
Glenvale Primary air monitoring reads HF at 0.11 ppm.
Aerial 1 thermal camera shows B4 skin at 28 C.

expected_effect.label: Peak indoor HF at Glenvale Primary

Card.confidence_reason: Testing with the observed smoke direction supports sheltering, but future wind changes remain uncertain.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If smoke changes direction or neighbouring enclosures heat, reassess protection and cooling.
sensor_concerns: The wind sensor disagrees with Aerial 1 smoke drift, so testing used wind from 239 degrees.

Card.headline: Cool B2 and keep B4 covered

actions.reason: Pumper 2 can cool B2 before its rising temperature becomes dangerous.

Card.rationale: Cool B2 early and keep Aerial 1 cooling B4. Keep Glenvale homes and Glenvale Primary sheltered as smoke drifts northeast.
evidence: B2 battery sensor reads 39 C, rising 7 C each minute.
Aerial 1 reports smoke drifting toward 53 degrees.
Glenvale Primary air monitor reads HF at 0.75 ppm.
Card.confidence_reason: The forecast gives B2 a 26% runaway risk, but testing shows no measurable cooling benefit.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If independent readings show B2 has stopped heating, reconsider its cooling stream.
sensor_concerns: The wind sensor disagrees with observed smoke, so testing used wind from 233 degrees.
A5 fixed gas detector reads 12%, but HAZMAT 1 verifies zero.

decisions.Trigger: A3's battery sensor reads 15°C, but the thermal camera shows about 52°C.

Card.headline: Keep cooling B2 and B4 and maintain shelter
Card.rationale: Keep Pumper 2 on B2, Aerial 1 on B4, and both communities sheltered. Testing A3 at 52 C showed no spread reduction from extra cooling.
evidence: Aerial 1's camera indicates about 52 C inside A3.
Aerial 1 reports smoke drifting northeast toward Glenvale Primary.
Glenvale Primary's air monitor reads HF at 1.25 ppm.
Card.confidence_reason: Corrected tests support current orders, but sensor faults limit confidence.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If A3 keeps heating on the thermal camera, start cooling it.
sensor_concerns: A3's battery sensor reads 15 C despite camera evidence indicating 52 C.
The wind sensor disagrees with smoke drift, so tests used wind from 222 degrees.
A4's fixed gas detector disagrees with HAZMAT 1's verified near-zero reading.

decisions.Trigger: Regular check that the plan is still right.

Card.headline: Keep the current plan
Card.rationale: Keep Pumper 2 cooling B2 and Aerial 1 cooling B4, with Glenvale homes and Glenvale Primary sheltered. Corrected tests show no spread benefit from two extra streams.
evidence: Aerial 1 reports smoke drifting toward Glenvale Primary at 42 degrees.
The thermal camera implies A3 is about 70 C inside.
Glenvale Primary air monitoring reads HF at 1.21 ppm.
Card.confidence_reason: Tests using corrected temperatures and observed smoke direction support holding, but sensors disagree.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If camera temperatures rise or smoke changes direction, reassess immediately.
sensor_concerns: A3 battery sensor reads 15 C despite camera evidence of hotter batteries.
B2 battery sensor is flat beside fire, though the camera confirms cooling.
The wind sensor disagrees with smoke drift, so tests used wind from 222 degrees.

decisions.Trigger: Regular check that the plan is still right.

Card.headline: Keep the current plan
Card.rationale: Keep Pumper 2 cooling B2, Aerial 1 cooling B4, and both communities sheltered. Adding streams at A3 and A4 showed no benefit after correcting the suspect readings.
evidence: Aerial 1 shows B2 and B4 skins near 22 C.
Aerial 1 shows A3 skin at 54 C, suggesting 81 C inside.
Glenvale Primary air monitoring shows HF at 0.88 ppm.
Card.confidence_reason: Corrected tests support current orders, but future wind changes remain uncertain.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If camera temperatures or school HF rise, reassess immediately.
sensor_concerns: A3 battery sensor reads 15 C despite a 54 C skin.
The wind sensor disagrees with smoke drift, so tests used wind from 231 degrees.
B6 fixed gas detector reads 14 percent, but HAZMAT 1 verifies below one percent.

decisions.Trigger: Regular check that the plan is still right.

Card.headline: Keep the current plan
Card.rationale: Keep Pumper 2 cooling B2 and Aerial 1 cooling B4. Maintain shelter at Glenvale homes and Glenvale Primary because toxic smoke still reaches the school.
evidence: Aerial 1 shows B2 at 16 C and B4 at 19 C.
Aerial 1 shows A3 skin at 55 C and A4 at 65 C.
Glenvale Primary air monitoring reads HF at 1.06 ppm.
Card.confidence_reason: Corrected tests show extra cooling adds no benefit over 20 minutes.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If A3 or A4 keeps heating, add cooling.
sensor_concerns: A3 battery sensor reads 15 C despite hot skin, so testing assumed 83 C inside.
The anemometer disagrees with smoke drift, so testing used wind from 229 degrees.
